name: Rolling return
condition: the rolling realised return over the last {window} settled bets is below zero and the 95% bootstrap upper bound of that window is below the strategy's expected return
threshold: rolling window 100 bets · upper bound < expected return
why: A live strategy that is losing money against its own expectation is not being paid for its edge; keeping it live converts a research candidate into a position that the evidence no longer supports.

name: Signal decay
condition: the mean probability edge over the last {window} bets falls below half the edge the strategy was registered on
why: The signal is the product. If the edge the strategy was registered on is no longer there, the reason to keep it live is gone, whatever the return did.

name: Sample decay
condition: fewer than {min_bets} settled bets in the last {window} bets' worth of weeks
threshold: fewer than 20 settled bets in 26 weeks
why: A strategy that has stopped generating settled bets cannot be monitored, and an unmonitored live strategy is an unmanaged one.

name: Provenance failure
condition: the quote-provenance gate (G1) fails at a weekly review
threshold: G1 must be true at every weekly review
why: Every return in this repository is computed against a community mirror's price. A live strategy requires an authenticated quote source; if that source is lost the return stops being measurable and the strategy must return to paper.

name: Redundancy
condition: another live strategy's bets overlap this strategy's bets by more than the redundancy threshold
why: Two live strategies that make the same bet are one strategy with two names; the competition would otherwise pay twice for one signal.

name: Promotion to candidate
condition: every gate passes on a window that was not used to register the strategy, and the quote-provenance gate passes
threshold: G1–G8 all true on fresh data
why: Eligibility is a fact about evidence, not about profit.

name: Promotion to live
condition: a prospective window with no demotion trigger fired, and the rolling return rule (D1) is satisfied on that window
threshold: no demotion trigger over the prospective window
why: Live status is a permission to be monitored, not a reward. It is granted by surviving the gate, and it is withdrawn by the same gate.
